scenario_scope: Intake of Corben Sorenson's When Success Stops Teaching as a cross-layer conceptual source for competence-dependent learning allocation, informative exceptions, evaluator improvement, least-invasive repair, recovery, and assurance.

cases.decision_rationale: The paper proposes a governed allocation and handoff discipline across existing learning, evidence, evaluation, repair, readiness, operations, and resource owners. Each mechanism has a current chapter boundary, so integration should clarify those interfaces without creating a super-owner.
evidence_transition_preconditions: equal-total-cost comparison where resource superiority is claimed
coverage, observability, failure, and evaluator-dependence accounting
promotion_blockers: conceptual architecture and experimental specification only
no GRBL implementation or SaturationShiftBench result
no independently checked theorem or full external-source review
non_claims: does not establish a universal superiority of negative learning
does not establish that a qualified competence envelope is complete
does not authorize learning, readiness, or deployment

cases.decision_rationale: A paper-shaped chapter would repeat learning-topology allocation, policy feedback, data custody, evaluator integrity, benchmark ratchets, capability qualification, procedural compilation, readiness, incident recovery, and integration responsibilities already assigned elsewhere.
required_before_drafting: not applicable; integrate through established owners
evidence_transition_preconditions: a future implemented GRBL service would require fresh boundary adjudication if it exposes a genuinely unowned lifecycle
promotion_blockers: a named six-plane architecture does not itself create a distinct stack layer
non_claims: does not forbid a future chapter if implementation reveals an unowned responsibility

validation_boundary: Records a complete-manuscript existing-owner integration and rejects a duplicate chapter. It does not validate the propositions, conjectures, evaluator ecology, benchmark design, repair compiler, safety, novelty, or resource advantage.
non_claims: does not add a Lean proof target
does not claim the supplied manifest proves manuscript truth
does not authorize training, deployment, release, or claim promotion
